Name: wmo_wis2_gc_downloaded_total
Description: Number of data items downloaded to Global Cache (not incremented when data items are retrieved from inline content)

Name: wmo_wis2_gc_downloaded_errors_total
Description: Number of download errors for Global Cache data

Name: wmo_wis2_gc_integrity_failed_total
Description: Number of messages for which the integrity check failed

Name: wmo_wis2_gc_user_downloaded_files_total
Description: Number of files downloaded successfully from the GC

Name: wmo_wis2_gc_user_donwloaded_bytes_total
Description: Size of data downloaded successfully from the GC

Name: wmo_wis2_gc_user_distinct_total
Description: Number of distinct users (as distinguished by their IP address) having downloaded data. Bin takes values 5m
